gaps.explanation: Schedule is 33,394 above the statement (12,419,453 vs 12,386,059). The governmental funds statement (trimmed p5, printed p7) prints 'Sale of surplus' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES): General Fund 29,154, Road Fund 4,240 (Total 33,394, p6). The budgetary comparison schedules count it inside 'Local' receipts: General Fund schedule (p10) Local 1,347,433 vs statement General Fund Local 1,318,279 (diff 29,154); Road Fund schedule (p11) Local 1,233,488 vs statement Road Fund Local 1,229,248 (diff 4,240). 29,154 + 4,240 = 33,394 = the gap. Both totals are printed (statement TOTAL RECEIPTS 12,386,059 p6; General budget 7,404,000 p10; Road budget 2,937,877 p11). The printed Local amounts cannot be split; no fix.

JSON other_financing 394,525 = 33,394 + 361,131. Detail has Road Fund schedule (p11) 'Bond proceeds' 12,685,000 and 'Premium on bond' 361,131 (non-transfer other-financing detail 13,046,131 = 12,685,000 + 361,131; gap -361,131 = the premium, which the JSON carries in other_financing). Against debt_proceeds + other_financing (13,079,525) detail is short by 33,394 = Sale of surplus, which the budget schedules include in Local receipts (see revenue gap: p10 Local 1,347,433 incl. 29,154; p11 Local 1,233,488 incl. 4,240), so adding it as other financing would count it twice. Nothing missing; no fix.
